records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the three months ended December 31, 2021, our average weekly sales were down 17% compared to pre-COVID levels, which represents continued improvement from the three months ended September 30, 2021 and December 31, 2020 when sales were down 25% and 40%, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in selling expenses was primarily due to variable costs, including payroll, associated with the higher sales volumes, as well as operating costs associated with our new distribution center in Rialto, California.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase was also attributable to a decline in our unfavorable production variances and inventory scrap write-downs due to the closure of our aged Houston, Texas plant during fiscal 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin improved 4.4% from 25.1% during the prior year period to 29.5% during the three months ended December 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash used in operating activities during the six months ended December 31, 2021 was $8.6 million as compared to net cash used of $3.8 million in the six months ended December 31, 2020.
